text:
[Council File 26-1161]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a proposed Agreement with Northeast LA Forest School for the operation of an outdoor, nature-based, recreational child development program within Elysian Park located at 1025 Elysian Park Drive.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. DETERMINE that the proposed Agreement is categorically exempt from the provisions of the California
Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Section 15301 [Operation, repair, maintenance, permitting, leasing, licensing, or minor alteration of existing public or private structures, facilities, mechanical equipment, or topographical features, involving negligible or no expansion of existing or former use] of the California CEQA Guidelines; and, Article III, Section 1, Class 1(14) of the City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE the proposed Agreement with Northeast LA Forest School (Organization), a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, setting forth the terms and conditions for the operation of an outdoor, nature-based, recreational child development program (Program) at designated areas within Elysian Park located at 1025 Elysian Park Drive, substantially in the form as Attachment 1 included in the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners (Board) report dated August 20, 2026, attached to the Council file.
3. AUTHORIZE the President and Secretary, Board, to execute the Agreement subsequent to all necessary approvals.
4. AUTHORIZE the Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP) to make any necessary technical changes consistent with the Board's intent in approving said Board report and proposed Agreement.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board reports that the proposed Agreement will have no adverse fiscal impact on the RAP's General Fund, as the Organization is self-sustaining. Operational and program costs will be covered by the Organization.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
